properties.site-address: Churchill Hospital and Ambulance Resource Centre, Oxford
properties.notes: The site is allocated as Policy SP19 for mixed use development in the Local Plan 2036, adopted in June 2020. The site is also allocated as part of Area of Change Policy AOC9 in the Local Plan 2036. Planning permission granted for demolition of existing buildings and construction of key worker housing (19 cluster units) and associated works, August 2020 (19/01039/FUL). This applicaton is on part of the site.
